## Content change

**Type:** new entry / update / story / other
**Entries touched:**

### Editor checklist (twice-weekly review)
- [ ] Facts match at least two sources (or one official source); links open
- [ ] Folklore is retold neutrally, attributed as tradition, with a note where versions differ
- [ ] Religious/cultural sensitivity: dress codes, entry rules, rituals described respectfully
- [ ] Timings, fees and dates are marked "confirm before travelling" or verified
- [ ] Images are licensed or owned
- [ ] `status` set to `approved` only after review
